heading.zh-Hant: 出身、軍旅與被推舉為保加利亞親王
heading.en: Birth, army service and election as Prince of Bulgaria

body.zh-Hant: 斐迪南生於維也納，屬薩克森－科堡－哥達家族，1881年加入奧匈軍隊。1886年亞歷山大·馮·巴騰堡在俄國壓力下離開保加利亞後，保加利亞人終於決定推舉他。他要求由保加利亞議會一致選出，1887年7月7日選舉完成；7月14日他在特爾諾沃宣誓遵守憲法，7月22日隆重進入索菲亞。
body.en: Ferdinand was born in Vienna, a prince of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha, and entered the Austro-Hungarian army in 1881. After Alexander of Battenberg had to leave Bulgaria under Russian pressure in 1886, the Bulgarians eventually agreed on Ferdinand. He demanded a unanimous election by the Bulgarian parliament, which took place on 7 July 1887; on 14 July he swore the oath on the constitution at Tirnovo, and on 22 July he made his ceremonial entry into Sofia.

heading.en: Years as prince and proclamation as tsar

body.zh-Hant: 他接任時面對艱難的處境：列強不承認他，俄國的敵意也在意料之中。在自治的東魯米利亞，他只是受蘇丹節制的「瓦利」。他一面爭取列強的外交承認，一面投入年輕軍隊的建設，並在學校、行政與交通方面逐步推進。1894年他解除了向來大權在握的首相斯坦博洛夫（Stambulow）的職務。1908年10月8日，他趁土耳其陷入困難，宣布自己為保加利亞人的沙皇，也使東魯米利亞最終併入保加利亞。
body.en: He found a difficult task: the Great Powers did not recognise him and Russian hostility was certain. In autonomous Eastern Rumelia he ruled only as a "Wali" dependent on the Sultan. While seeking diplomatic recognition from the Powers, he devoted himself to building up the young army and made gradual progress in schools, administration and transport. In 1894 he dismissed the hitherto all-powerful prime minister Stambolov. Exploiting Turkey's difficulties, on 8 October 1908 he had himself proclaimed "King (Tsar) of the Bulgarians", which also meant the final incorporation of Eastern Rumelia.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年他為瓜分歐洲境內殘餘的土耳其領土，與塞爾維亞結盟。第一次巴爾幹戰爭（1912至1913年）中各盟國取得大勝，征服馬其頓與色雷斯，推進到愛琴海邊與君士坦丁堡城前，並於1913年5月30日簽訂倫敦和約。馬其頓歸屬之爭引發第二次巴爾幹戰爭（1913年6月），土耳其重新參戰，羅馬尼亞攻擊保加利亞，使保加利亞孤立無援。1913年8月10日，保加利亞在布加勒斯特和約中放棄馬其頓與東色雷斯，並把南多布羅甲讓給羅馬尼亞。
body.en: In 1912 he allied himself with Serbia for the partition of the remaining European Turkey. In the First Balkan War (1912/13) the allies won great victories, conquering Macedonia and Thrace and advancing to the Aegean and to the gates of Constantinople; the Peace of London followed on 30 May 1913. The dispute over Macedonia led to the Second Balkan War (June 1913); Turkey took up the fight again and Romania attacked Bulgaria, which stood alone. In the Peace of Bucharest of 10 August 1913 Bulgaria had to give up Macedonia and Eastern Thrace and cede the southern Dobruja to Romania.

heading.en: Entry into the First World War and abdication

body.zh-Hant: 1915年中央同盟國在東線獲勝，戰爭似乎即將定局，他希望藉此取得馬其頓，9月6日以同盟國盟友身分參戰。保加利亞軍隊參與了1915年擊潰塞爾維亞與1916年擊潰羅馬尼亞的行動。與中央同盟國在多布羅甲和愛琴海沿岸歸屬上的政治歧見，加上戰事久拖，削弱了保加利亞的軍事抵抗力。1918年9月，保加利亞的馬其頓戰線被協約國薩洛尼卡軍隊突破，他於10月3日讓位給王儲並離開國家。
body.en: In the hope of gaining Macedonia, and after the victories of the Central Powers on the Eastern Front in 1915 had made a quick decision seem likely, he entered the war as an ally of the Central Powers on 6 September 1915. Bulgarian troops helped to defeat Serbia (1915) and Romania (1916). Political disagreements with the Central Powers over the fate of the Dobruja and the Aegean coast, and the long duration of the war, eroded Bulgarian military resistance. When the Allied Salonika army broke through the Macedonian front in September 1918, he abdicated in favour of the crown prince on 3 October 1918 and left the country.

heading.en: Exile in Coburg and last years

body.zh-Hant: 退位後，奧地利拒絕讓他居留，他前往科堡度過晚年，完全不過問政治，也不曾再踏上保加利亞。他研究動物學與植物學，特別是蘭花、蝴蝶與鳥類，並從科堡出發，直到高齡仍進行前往非洲與南美洲的科學考察。1942年埃爾朗根（Erlangen）授予他榮譽自然科學博士。他於1948年在科堡去世。
body.en: After his abdication Austria refused him residence; he went to Coburg, where he spent his last years, kept entirely away from politics and never entered Bulgaria again. He pursued zoological and botanical studies, especially orchids, butterflies and ornithology, and from Coburg undertook scientific expeditions to Africa and South America into old age. Erlangen awarded him an honorary doctorate in natural sciences in 1942. He died in Coburg in 1948.

body.zh-Hant: 阿亞拉出身穆伊亞佩（Mbuyapey）的貧寒家庭，少年時就顯露才華，在自由黨內迅速晉升。1890年代他遷往亞松森，就讀國立學院（Colegio Nacional），1904年起任教，開設哲學、公民、心理學與邏輯課程，1908年取得大學法學博士學位。
body.en: Ayala was born in Mbuyapey to humble parents, displayed considerable talent early and rose rapidly in the ranks of the Liberal Party. In the 1890s he moved to Asunción, where he attended the Colegio Nacional and began teaching in 1904, giving courses in philosophy, civics, psychology and logic; in 1908 he received a doctorate in law from the university.

heading.zh-Hant: 從政、流亡歐洲與出任財政部長
heading.en: Politics, exile in Europe and finance minister

body.zh-Hant: 他曾任窮人的代理律師、民事法官與國會議員，也以自由黨中堅身分參與1904年與1911年的革命，之後離開巴拉圭，在歐洲度過八年。一戰後返國，投入教學與新聞工作，重新取得國會議席，1920年由總統曼努埃爾·貢德拉任命為財政部長。他很快以誠實與冷靜聞名；他不附和許多自由黨人的沙文主義，主張與玻利維亞就查科爭議地區進行談判。
body.en: He held office as attorney for the indigent, civil judge and congressional deputy. After taking part in the revolutions of 1904 and 1911 as a Liberal stalwart he left Paraguay and spent eight years in Europe. On his return after the First World War he devoted himself to teaching and journalism, regained his congressional seat and in 1920 was appointed finance minister by President Manuel Gondra. He quickly gained a reputation for honesty and level-headedness, shunned the jingoism of many Liberals and favoured negotiations with Bolivia over the disputed Chaco.

body.zh-Hant: 1923年他擔任巴拉圭臨時總統，一年後當選總統。他的任內帶來二十多年來第一段國內和平。他著手改革陳舊的財政制度，平衡國家預算、穩定貨幣，並償還相當部分的政府債務。巴拉圭重新取得國際信貸後，他為新建的軍隊購買軍火，並為海軍添購兩艘軍艦，同時推動軍隊專業化，為即將到來的查科戰爭做準備。他任期的最後一年，邊境事件接連發生，蓋過了先前的成就。
body.en: In 1923 he served as provisional president of Paraguay and was elected to that office a year later. His administration brought the first spate of internal peace in more than twenty years. Bent on reforming the archaic fiscal system, he balanced the budget, stabilised the currency and paid off a considerable part of the government debt. With renewed access to international credit he bought munitions for the fledgling army and two warships for the navy, and promoted the professionalisation of the armed forces in preparation for the Chaco War. In the last year of his administration a series of border incidents overshadowed the progress.

body.zh-Hant: 1928年他在繼任者何塞·P·吉加里（José P. Guggiari）的政府中再度出任財政部長，並仍保有自由黨的幾項重要職務。兩年後，他在亞松森遇害，死亡日為1930年10月24日。
body.en: In 1928 he resumed the post of finance minister in the government of his successor, José P. Guggiari, and kept several key posts in the Liberal Party. Two years later he was killed in Asunción; he died on 24 October 1930.

people.name: Alfredo Baquerizo Moreno
people.nameZh: 阿爾弗雷多·巴克里索·莫雷諾

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾弗雷多·巴克里索·莫雷諾1859年9月28日生於瓜亞基爾。他在投身政壇之前，已以散文與詩歌作家的身分聞名。他也曾是瓜亞基爾大學的教授。
body.en: Alfredo Baquerizo Moreno was born in Guayaquil on 28 September 1859. Before embarking on a political career he earned distinction as a writer of prose and poetry. He was also a former professor at the University of Guayaquil.

heading.zh-Hant: 公職歷程與1912年代理總統
heading.en: Public offices and acting president in 1912

body.zh-Hant: 他歷任多項政府職務，包括瓜亞基爾市長、外交部長、瓜亞斯省參議員、參議院議長與副總統，並在1912年8月出任代理總統。
body.en: He held various government posts, including mayor of Guayaquil, minister of foreign relations, senator for Guayas Province, president of the Senate and vice president, and was acting president in August 1912.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年他作為普拉薩·古鐵雷斯（Leónidas Plaza Gutiérrez）親自挑選的接班人當選總統，選舉因嚴重舞弊指控而蒙上陰影。他延續1895至1925年自由主義時代的改革，1918年簽署法律，正式廢除債務監禁與強制勞動制「concertaje」。他與哥倫比亞簽訂1916年穆尼奧斯·韋爾納薩—蘇亞雷斯條約，解決了長期的邊界爭端。1919年其政府協助洛克斐勒基金會在瓜亞基爾推行成功的黃熱病防治運動。他也致力推動公共教育，但可可出口銳減使經濟轉弱，削弱了施政成效。
body.en: He was president of Ecuador from 1916 to 1920. His 1916 election as the hand-picked successor of Leónidas Plaza Gutiérrez was marred by serious fraud allegations. He continued the reforms of the liberal era (1895-1925), signing legislation in 1918 that legally ended debtors' prisons and concertaje (forced labor). He resolved the boundary dispute with Colombia with the Muñoz Vernaza-Suárez Treaty of 1916. His administration helped the Rockefeller Foundation carry out a successful anti-yellow fever campaign in Guayaquil in 1919. He sought to advance public education, but the sharp decline in cacao sales weakened his administration's efforts.

heading.en: Interim president in 1931-1932 and last years

body.zh-Hant: 1931年他七十二歲時，再度短暫出任臨時總統，任期自1931年9月至1932年8月。他於1951年3月20日在紐約市去世。
body.en: At the age of seventy-two he briefly served again as interim president, from September 1931 to August 1932. He died in New York City on 20 March 1951.

from September 1931 to August 1932
He died in New York City on March 20, 1951.
